findings.title: Property without domain
findings.message: Property “is in scheme” has no domain.
findings.subject: http://www.w3.org/2004/02/skos/core#inScheme

rules.title: Ontology has no title
rules.description: Add dcterms:title (or rdfs:label) to the owl:Ontology node.

rules.title: Ontology has no description
rules.description: Add dcterms:description or dcterms:abstract so readers know what the ontology is for.

rules.title: No license declared
rules.description: Declare a license with dcterms:license so others know how they may reuse the ontology.

rules.title: No version information
rules.description: Add owl:versionInfo and owl:versionIRI to make releases citable and comparable.

rules.title: No creators
rules.description: Credit the authors with dcterms:creator.

rules.title: No preferred prefix/namespace
rules.description: Add vann:preferredNamespacePrefix and vann:preferredNamespaceUri.

rules.title: Term without a label
rules.description: Every term should have a human-readable rdfs:label or skos:prefLabel (OOPS! P08).

rules.title: Term without a definition
rules.description: Every term should have a definition (skos:definition, IAO:0000115 or rdfs:comment) (OOPS! P08).

rules.title: Property without domain
rules.description: Consider declaring rdfs:domain (OOPS! P11). Ignored when the property is used in class axioms.

rules.title: Property without range
rules.description: Consider declaring rdfs:range (OOPS! P11).

rules.title: Cycle in class hierarchy
rules.description: A class is (indirectly) a subclass of itself, which makes the classes equivalent (OOPS! P06).

rules.title: Undeclared term
rules.description: A term in the ontology namespace is used but never declared (no rdf:type) (OOPS! P34/P35).

rules.title: Duplicate labels
rules.description: Two or more terms share the same label, which confuses readers and tools.

rules.title: Multiple labels in one language
rules.description: A term has more than one rdfs:label/skos:prefLabel in the same language.

rules.title: Deprecated term without replacement
rules.description: Deprecated terms should point to their replacement with dcterms:isReplacedBy.

rules.title: Inconsistent naming convention
rules.description: Classes are usually UpperCamelCase and properties lowerCamelCase (OOPS! P22).

rules.title: Class both subclass of and disjoint with another
rules.description: A class that is a subclass of a class it is disjoint with is unsatisfiable.

rules.title: Transitive property used as functional
rules.description: In OWL 2 DL a transitive property cannot be functional or inverse functional.

rules.title: Self-referencing definition
rules.description: A class is declared equivalent to or a subclass of itself (OOPS! P24/P27).

rules.title: Orphan class
rules.description: A class with no superclass, no subclasses and no usage is disconnected from the model.

rules.title: Wrong kind of range
rules.description: Datatype properties must have a datatype range and object properties a class range (OOPS! P31-like).

rules.title: Inverse of itself but not symmetric
rules.description: A property declared as inverse of itself should be declared symmetric instead (OOPS! P25).

rules.title: Missing language tags
rules.description: When some labels carry language tags, all of them should (helps multilingual docs).

rules.title: Term outside the ontology namespace
rules.description: Declared terms that live in other namespaces are documented as external.

rules.title: Multiple domains or ranges
rules.description: Several rdfs:domain (or range) axioms are interpreted as their intersection, which is often not intended (OOPS! P19).
